source: ECONOMY [buy versus sell], rule 242(c): 'a town short of a thing pays more for it and the stall says so in a word'
note: The stall keeper's lines for the SELL side, an attempt for WORDS and RUN TWO (rule 8/11: words get an attempt). Never read by the game until RUN TWO or WORDS takes them. The keeper speaks, never the player (rule 150; the player does not speak Spanglish, the first votes); the keeper's Spanglish rolls at runtime (WORDS rule 143a), so most lines are plain. {n} is how many more the town wants, {sell} what the next one brings.

calm_sell.text: Half what I sell it for. That's the deal, same as everywhere.
I'll take it. Half price, I've got to sell it again.

short_food.text: We're short on food here. I'll pay {sell} a night for {n} more.
People are hungry, mijo. Bring me food and I pay good, {n} more.

short_meds.text: They need meds here. {sell} a dose, for {n} more.
Half the block is coughing. Every dose you've got, I'll take {n}.

need_met.text: That's what we needed. Back to the usual price.

plenty.text: We're drowning in it. I can't take more this week.

warn_food.text: That's your crew's dinner tonight. Still want to sell it?

undo.text: Changed your mind? Same price back, no hard feelings.
